title: 중수청, 국고채 입찰 담합 의혹 사건 반독점국에 배당
caption:
South Korea’s top financial firms were found to have pre‑agreed Treasury‑bond rates in nearly every auction, drawing a trillion‑won fine. The investigation shows how covert coordination can hurt public finances.
